actual_run_003_diagnosis.observation: Read-only resume opened history in the active linked SEO pane. The list contained one row carrying the saved response ID; the UI badge existed, but the runner parsed its count as zero. Resource watch was healthy and the child exited unverified at history_list_wait.
actual_run_003_diagnosis.root_cause: A regex inside the Runtime.evaluate JavaScript template used backslash-d. JavaScript template cooking removed the backslash, turning the browser regex into a literal d check. A numeric badge therefore fell through to zero. This is a harness oracle defect, not evidence of a product history failure.
actual_run_003_diagnosis.repair: The runner now reads the component's single numeric count span and applies a template-safe [0-9] regex. It still requires the rendered row count to equal the badge and the actual saved row ID to be present. No Save is attempted on read-only resume.

harness_defect.sibling_census: Read-only TypeScript AST scan of 104 tests/browser .mjs/.cjs files inspected raw template chunks for single backslash regex-class escapes d/D/s/S/w/W/b/B. It found zero candidates after the targeted repair. Ripgrep candidates in ordinary regex literals and doubly escaped template text were reviewed as separate syntax; no additional confirmed cooked-regex sibling was found. This does not prove every embedded regex form is safe.

scope: At most one new public IANA audit row in the explicitly selected existing campaign test organization, identified through the real Save response and stable history/snapshot DOM attributes.

identity_contract.production_ui: History button and selected Saved snapshot expose the same existing row UUID as data-audit-id. The attribute changes no visible copy or database/API shape.
identity_contract.real_save_response: The runner observes, without interception or replay, the real POST to wbx_seo_audit for the exact public URL and selected organization and reads only its returned ID from the response body.
identity_contract.history: The selected URL's rendered history must contain that exact ID; the clicked row's selected snapshot must expose the same ID before and after a new panel document reload. Count growth is not used because history is capped at 25.

durable_one_write_guard: Before the trusted Save click, the runner syncs the repository directory after creating test-results, exclusively creates and syncs the 0600 checkpoint file, then syncs test-results so its new directory entry survives a crash. Any unsupported fsync stops before mutation. The checkpoint is keyed to the selected on-device organization ID and SHA-256 of the public URL. The later response-ID update writes and syncs a temporary file, renames it over the checkpoint, then syncs test-results. A rerun with an ID skips Save; a checkpoint without an ID refuses another Save.
